REFLECTION.intent_reanchor: Q0: does splice STRENGTH (not bulk composition) name the payload, net of composition? ANSWER: bulk composition is REFUTED as the payload's identity, but strength is NOT robustly established either -> semantic identity UNRESOLVED.
REFLECTION.composition_refuted: CV-R2(S~Z)=-0.07(H)/+0.006(D): bulk composition has no out-of-sample power to predict the payload transfer. Collinearity(dV2b~Z) low (-0.005 H); common support 53-69>40; confound gate A beta=-0.02 covers 0; gate B beta=0.98 covers 1; planted-positive detected (beta=0.77); permuted FPR=0.05. => composition separable and EXCLUDED (identifiable).
REFLECTION.estimator_correction: GBR-DML OVERFIT the low-dim Z (negative OOF R2) and manufactured a phantom nonlinear confound; LINEAR (ridge) DML is the calibrated estimator. Confound plant rebuilt FOLD-FREE (full-fit) to remove OOF fold-coupling.
REFLECTION.strength_weak_unstable: Broad DML (a9b-val): V2b beta=+0.042 [-0.02,+0.12] H (incl0), +0.009 D; V3 +0.042 [+0.001,+0.09] H only (circular). Path-A reproduces A9 EXACTLY on a9-val (r=-0.512 H / -0.323 D) but across 5 independently-seeded draws H r ranged -0.512..+0.017 (mean -0.22), D ~0; every composition-adjusted dyadic CI includes 0 (see a9c_sweep_seeded_draws).
REFLECTION.R22: C30 downgraded: A9's -0.51 reproducible on a9-val (not an implementation error) but sample-unstable + non-significant under two-way gene-dyadic inference. Payload = acceptor-local + NOT bulk composition; semantic identity UNRESOLVED; weak negative directional tendency only (H 4/5 draws neg, 4/4 comp-matched neg). V3 no rescue (circular + split-inconsistent).
methodology_lessons: Within-sample gene held-out (D/H) does NOT test sampling stability -- the whole draw is one tag-seeded sample; require multiple independently-seeded (ideally disjoint) draws.
Interchange pairs reuse sender/receiver genes -> two-way (dyadic) inference, not permutation-on-correlation.
REFLECTION.next: Absolute MaxEnt strength probably NOT the semantic target -> test conditional splice competitiveness (donor context, competing acceptors, intronic context; IC1-IC5). Weak-tendency quantification -> new preregistered pooled disjoint-gene two-way-dyadic meta-analysis.
